title: [Decision] #23217 cannot land as ruled: four of the five request-to-context doors cannot import an internal function of `@objectstack/runtime`. Home it in `@objectstack/core` (a new export), keep five copies under a parity pin, or close
body:
Ruled: 6227928430 · letter A · 2026-10-17T01:25Z

**维护者速读.** You ruled (C′, item 3) that the platform's five copies of "turn a request into the caller's identity and tenant" become one internal function inside the runtime package. Measured today: four of the five copies live in packages that cannot reach the runtime package at all, and one of them (the REST server) would make a dependency loop. The only package all five already share is the core package, so one shared function there means one new published export, which C′ said not to add. A: put it in core as an export (one function, every door calls it). B: keep five copies but pin them to give the same answer with a test. C: close the card. **A / B / C?**

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`, at the claim attempt on #23217. ⛔ Not a claim. #23217 is held `pm:blocked` on this card.

## Background

#23217 (p3 housekeeping, filed from ruling C′ `6142279866`, item 3) asks for "one INTERNAL function in `@objectstack/runtime` … not a published export" that five platform doors call instead of each hand-rolling the request-to-context composition. Those doors are `resolveAuthzContext`, `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture`, `assembleExecutionContext` / `…OrGuest`, plus a session read. The harm it removes is drift: each copy was fixed separately when an input was omitted (#15351, #15352, #22258, #15747).

## Governing text

Ruling C′ item 3, verbatim: "consolidated into one INTERNAL function in `@objectstack/runtime`: a p3 housekeeping card, not a published export". AGENTS.md: a new export takes `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and at least a `minor`.

## The premise, re-checkable (`origin/main` `e9301e8a9f`)

- `@objectstack/runtime`'s `exports` map has one entry, `.`. A function not on `.` cannot be imported by another package.
- Of the five door packages, only the runtime itself depends on `@objectstack/runtime`. `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/service-settings`, `@objectstack/service-storage` and `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` do not. Re-check: `git show origin/main:<pkg>/package.json | grep -c '"@objectstack/runtime"'` reads 0 for each.
- `@objectstack/runtime` depends on `@objectstack/rest` (`packages/runtime/package.json` `:42`), so rest importing runtime would be a cycle.
- All five depend on `@objectstack/core`. Core's `.` entry already exports the pieces the composition uses: `assembleExecutionContext`, `assembleExecutionContextOrGuest`, `resolveAuthzContext`, and `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture`. The last one is the precedent: a shared door helper exported from core so several packages call one function (#16013).

## The question

Where does the one function live, given that the ruled home cannot be reached by four of the five callers?

## Options

| Option | What is built | What a customer notices | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** · one function in `@objectstack/core`, exported beside `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture` | the function plus five door conversions, each proven by that door's existing pins | nothing (no behaviour change); one more export on core's published entry | `domain:cli` with cross-lane declarations · 2–3 PRs (core + runtime first, then the other doors) · no direct precedent for the conversions; `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture` (#16013) is the precedent for the home |
| **B** · keep five copies, add one parity pin | a conformance test that drives the same requests through all five doors and requires one identical context | nothing | `domain:cli` · 1 PR · no precedent |
| **C** · close #23217 | nothing | nothing | none |

**In business terms:**
- **A** is one front desk that every entrance sends visitors to.
- **B** keeps five front desks but checks every day that they hand out the same badge.
- **C** keeps five desks and trusts them.

## Four axes

- **① Long-term soundness.** A leaves one composition. Two years from now, a new door calls one function, as mainstream frameworks have one request-to-principal resolver (Spring Security's filter chain, ASP.NET's authentication middleware). B keeps five copies and only detects drift after it is written. C keeps the drift class open.
- **② Real business pull.** No customer sees the copies. The pull is the four past incidents where one door omitted an input another had (#15351, #15352, #22258, #15747), each a security- or tenancy-relevant miss found late.
- **③ Preventing AI mistakes.** With A, an AI writing a sixth door finds one function to call. If it copies anyway, the copy is visibly a copy. With B, an AI that writes a sixth door outside the pin's list drifts silently unless the pin discovers doors itself. With C, nothing stops it.
- **④ Startup focus.** C adds nothing. B adds a test. A adds one published export, a permanent obligation, against C′'s "not a published export".

**Recommendation: A**, from ① alone. One resolver is the end state, and core already hosts its sibling `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture` for the same reason. **Fallback: B.** **Confidence gap:** the conversions are not measured yet; a door that intentionally differs keeps its difference as a named parameter, and that count is unknown until the first PR. Self-check: on ① alone, A. Do ②③④ flip it? No: ④ argues for B or C, but ②③④ only set the timing, and A can land one door at a time.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 收敛为一个解析函数，缩小特例；B 保留五份副本，只靠测试拦漂移；C 不变。
- ② 实际业务拉动:无客户可见拉动；拉动来自四次单门漏输入的事故(#15351、#15352、#22258、#15747)。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 让新门有唯一可调用的函数；B 只在门被列入测试时拦得住；C 无防护。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 在 core 的已发布入口多一个导出(永久义务)；B 多一个测试；C 不增加任何东西。

Prior rulings read: "request-to-context resolver", "classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture export core" → ruling C′ `6142279866` (item 3), #16013 (the core export precedent); ADR-0069, ADR-0096; thread: #23128.

## After the ruling

- **A:** #23217 is unblocked with its home amended to `@objectstack/core` (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `minor` for `@objectstack/core`). Slice 1 is the function plus the runtime's own door. Each later door is its own slice, declared to its lane, proven by its existing pins plus one ADR-0096 / ADR-0069 pin per door.
- **B:** #23217's body is amended to "one parity pin over the five doors, discovering them by census", and it is dispatched as one slice.
- **C:** #23217 closes `not_planned`, citing this ruling.

Related: #23217, #23128, ruling C′ `6142279866`, #16013, #15351, #15352, #22258, #15747.
